$description: Field family tokens: input, textarea, label and field anatomy, input group, native select and select, input OTP, kbd; round 8: the upload box (dropzone) and fields on glass when invalid. DECIDED 13 Oct 2026 (approved on the review board, F-D072 to F-D075), first shown in round 7, 13 Oct 2026. Fields are one of the few white things in Fume, with a hairline so they do not vanish; everything else is a role from ui.tokens.json. Build: node tools/tokens/build.mjs

bg.description: White. A field is one of the three white things in Fume (with the creative and the secondary button), always with its hairline.

edge.description: The hairline at rest: the same edge as the white secondary button, so a field and the button beside it read as one family. The only stroke a field has (rule few-strokes allows it: without it a white field vanishes on Porcelain).

edge-hover.description: Hover with a mouse: the hairline steps toward Ink. Never a fill change.

edge-invalid.description: Rouge edge on a field that holds an error, always with a message in words under it.

placeholder.description: Placeholder and addon text (https://, kr): 5.8:1, never lighter.

icon.description: Icons inside a field (search, chevrons, paperclip).

bg-pressed.description: A select trigger or a choice card while it is pressed: one step toward Ink, like the white button.

bg-readonly.description: Read-only: the value sits in the page instead of on it. No hairline, full Ink text, still selectable and focusable.

bg-disabled.description: Disabled: sunken like a disabled button, no hairline.

fg-disabled.description: Text in a disabled field and its label.

error.description: The error message under a field: Rouge, weight 500, after the circle-alert icon. 4.9:1 on Porcelain.

height-sm.description: 32 px. Dense tables and toolbars, with a mouse only: 44 on touch screens.

height.description: 40 px, the default field. On touch screens every field is --ui-size-hit (44) tall with 16 px text (rules touch-target, fields-16-on-touch).

height-lg.description: 48 px, with 16 px text: sign-in and marketing forms.

pad.description: 14 px from the field's edge to its text, more than three quarters of the 12 px corner.

pad-block.description: 12 px above and below the text in a textarea.

textarea-min.description: A textarea starts at three lines and grows with its text.

textarea-max.description: Where a growing textarea stops and scrolls.

list-max.description: The tallest an open select listbox gets before it scrolls (less when the window is shorter): about seven rows.

gap-label.description: 8 px from a label down to its control (rule proximity).

gap-hint.description: 4 px from a control down to its description or error: they belong to it.

gap.description: 24 px between fields: three times the label gap, so every label clearly belongs to the field under it.

gap-group.description: 32 px between field sets (groups of fields).

gap-legend.description: 16 px from a field set's legend (and its description) to its first field.

glass-bg.description: A field on glass: a faint Porcelain veil, no stroke. Focus shows the Porcelain ring.

glass-placeholder.description: Placeholder, icons and addons on glass: 88 % Porcelain, weight 500.

glass-edge-invalid.description: Round 8. A field on glass that holds an error: a 2 px band of solid Rouge just inside a 1 px Porcelain rim (--ui-field-glass-edge-invalid-rim). Rouge alone against Smoke measured 1.3:1 over a white page and 2.5:1 over the photo, too weak to read as an edge; the rim draws the edge (6.4:1 or more against the glass) and the Rouge reads against the rim at 4.9:1. The words under the field stay the first signal.

glass-edge-invalid-rim.description: Round 8. The 1 px Porcelain rim outside the Rouge band of an invalid field on glass: the same Rouge cut with Porcelain as the alert disc beside the words.

glass-error.description: Round 8. The error message on glass is Porcelain, weight 500, never Rouge. Measured on the board: Rouge words on Smoke 1.3:1 over a white page and 1.6 to 3.2:1 over the photo; Porcelain words 6.4:1 over a white page and 8.0:1 or more over the photo.

glass-error-mark.description: Round 8. The circle-alert before an error on glass: the same solid Rouge disc as on light ground, its exclamation cut through to Porcelain (--ui-field-glass-error-cut) instead of to the glass, so the mark reads 4.9:1 over any backdrop.

glass-error-cut.description: Round 8. What shows through the exclamation of the Rouge alert disc on glass: Porcelain.

slot-width.description: One slot of a sign-in code at full size. Slots narrow evenly on a phone; the code stays one line.

slot-height.description: Taller than a field: the code is the one thing on its screen.

gap.description: 8 px between slots in a group.

separator.description: The separator between groups of three is space, not a line: 8 more, so groups sit 24 apart, three times the gap inside a group.

caret.description: The caret in the active empty slot: Ink.

height.description: A key: a soft sunken pill, 22 px, a circle for one character.

pad.description: 6 px at each end of a key, past half its radius, so a one-character key stays a circle and Esc a short pill.

bg.description: Sunken, no stroke: the key is pressed into the surface, not drawn on it.

fg.description: Key labels, in the data face.

glass-bg.description: A key on glass (tooltips, menus, the command bar): the clear veil.

bg.description: Round 8. The upload box: one step of sunken surface, a well pressed into the page. No dashed border and no stroke at all (rule few-strokes): the step is the edge.

bg-hover.description: Hover with a mouse: one step toward Ink.

bg-pressed.description: Pressed: stays on the hover step and shrinks (dropzone.press-scale), so a large surface never flashes dark.

bg-drag.description: Drag-over: the well keeps its resting Fog; the seat turning Ink is the sign, with the words that say where creatives go. No fill, no Amber and no shimmer here (round 11, Marcus 13 Oct: 'verken orange eller shimmer på where creatives land'); round 9 had Amber 50 (beige), round 8 Focus 300.

fg.description: The line that says what to do: Ink, weight 500.

meta.description: The limits line (JPG, PNG or MP4 · up to 200 MB) in the data face: secondary, not tertiary, so it keeps 7.3:1 on the hover step and 5.8:1 on the drag step.

disc.description: The round seat of the upload icon: Porcelain, lifted off the well with depth.raised. It is the one raised thing in the box.

disc-drag.description: The seat of the upload icon while creatives are over the box: Ink, the one dark thing in the box, so it reads as the place to aim (round 11; round 10's Amber seat was wrong here).

disc-drag-fg.description: The upload icon on the Ink seat: Porcelain.

disc-size-compact.description: 32 px seat in the one-row variant and in the Add more row.

height.description: The empty box: tall enough to aim a drop at, short enough to sit above a form. Content centred, 24 inset all round.

height-compact.description: The one-row variant (Reference images in a form) and the Add more row under added creatives: taller than a 40 px field so it reads as a place to drop, not a field to type in.

press-scale.description: A box is wide, so it shrinks like a card (0.985), half a button's 3 %.

tile-min.description: Smallest thumbnail of an added creative: three across on a phone, also inside a dialog on a phone (310 px inside). In a wider box a tile is at least 14 % of it (dropzone.css), so a desktop box or a 640 px dialog shows six across.

gap.description: 24 px between the groups inside an upload: added creatives, rows still uploading, the Add more row. Rows inside a group sit 4 apart, tiles 24 down and 12 across with their caption 8 under them.

glass-bg.description: The box on glass: the clear veil, no stroke. Porcelain text on it is 5.0:1 over the worst backdrop.

glass-bg-hover.description: Hover on glass: the veil lifts like a clear button.

glass-bg-drag.description: Creatives dragged over the box on glass: the well deepens toward Ink instead of lighting up, so Porcelain text gains contrast while you aim.

glass-disc.description: The icon's seat on glass, and the tile of a row's creative that has nothing to show yet: a clear veil, never white (the one white thing on a glass surface is its main button).
